title: Seed walkers
text: A gentle walk or slow jog with no pressure. For beginners, families, recovery and anyone not ready to run fast.

title: Aerobics
text: Led aerobics to warm up or wind down. No distance, just good energy.

title: Steady runners
text: Relaxed running and conversation. Some Saturdays we keep it to 3 km, other days we stretch to 10 km.

title: Long runners
text: Longer loops for marathon and half marathon goals.
